entities.name: Steinbjørn B. Jacobsen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Steinbjørn Berghamar Jacobsen was a Faroese poet, teacher and writer. He was known as a children's writer, but his works also included short stories, plays and novels. He was awarded the Faroese Literature Prize for fiction in 1981.
